meta.title: ShortlistBuddy — AI Travel Photo Curation
meta.description: Turn 1,000 vacation photos into 50 perfect memories. AI-powered selection, configurable criteria, instant download.

guides.indexLead: Practical guides on choosing, organising and printing your holiday photos.
guides.ctaText: Let ShortlistBuddy do the first pass — turn your holiday photos into a reviewable shortlist in minutes.

hero.title: 1,000 travel photos.
hero.subtitle: AI analyses your vacation photos and picks the best ones. You review, adjust, and download — or send them straight to a photobook.
hero.demoNote: Demo mode — no account needed, runs on your device

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.step1Desc: Drop your photos here or connect a cloud provider (e.g. Dropbox, OneDrive, Google Photos, iCloud). We only read thumbnails — your originals stay on your device.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Our AI rates composition, faces, landscapes, animals, duplicates and more — in seconds — and proposes a selection. Add your own criteria (e.g. “dog”) once, before the analysis; afterwards just move the sliders to rebalance.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Based on your criteria and target count, the AI proposes a selection. Confirm the photos, re-select with different criteria, or add/remove individual shots — as long and as often as you like, until your preferred set is ready. The chosen photos are sorted by date and location.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Download your selection as a ZIP to keep it locally or in the cloud. You can also use that set directly to create a photo book.

showcase.title: From a thousand shots to your best few
showcase.subtitle: ShortlistBuddy highlights the keepers and quietly sets the rest aside — you stay in control.

pricing.title: Simple pricing
pricing.subtitle: Start free. Pay only when you need more.

upload.supported: Supports JPEG, PNG, HEIC. Up to {limit} photos.

upload.someFailed: {count} photo(s) couldn't be processed and won't be included.

criteria.title: Configure selection criteria
criteria.subtitle: Toggle criteria on/off and adjust their importance. The AI will prioritise accordingly.
criteria.facesDesc: Prefer photos with open eyes and friendly expressions
criteria.landscapesDesc: Include scenic views typical of the region
criteria.foodDesc: Include the best food and restaurant shots
criteria.diversityDesc: Ensure a balanced mix of different scene types
criteria.selectionPercentageDesc: AI will choose between 1 and up to 30% of all photos.
criteria.sliderLegend: No slider: balanced · 1–9: more of that subject · 10: only that subject
criteria.modeOnly: Only: {motifs} — every matching photo (series are collapsed).
criteria.customDesc: Your own terms (e.g. “car”, “dog”). Exclusions work too — for example “no snow”. Up to 7.
criteria.customSetupHint: Set every term you want before the first “Analyze” — they're locked for this run afterwards.
criteria.customLockedNote: Custom criteria are locked once the analysis has run. Start a new job for a different set.
criteria.customFilterActive: Exclusion filter active — photos containing this are always removed, regardless of other criteria.
criteria.personsDesc: Upload reference photos and name people — the AI then filters for photos where they are recognised.
criteria.personsConsent: Note: reference photos are sent to our LLM provider for face matching and held only for this session. They are not stored beyond the session. Please only upload photos of people who have consented.
criteria.personsProcessFailed: Could not process this photo. Please try a different image.
criteria.personsAddFailed: Could not add person. Check name and count.
criteria.personsSetupHint: Up to {max} persons — set before the first “Analyse”.
criteria.personsLockedNote: Persons are locked once the analysis has run. Start a new job to change them.
criteria.personFilterActive: Exclusion filter active — photos with {name} are always removed, regardless of other criteria.
criteria.aiNotice: Note: ShortlistBuddy uses artificial intelligence to create a non-binding selection proposal. Only reduced previews are sent to Google Gemini for analysis; Google may retain transmitted images and outputs for abuse monitoring for up to 55 days. Please review the result and keep your originals separately.
criteria.ageConfirm: I am at least 18 years old and accept the Terms of Use.
criteria.personsConfirm: I confirm that I use all reference photos solely for private purposes among family or friends and that the required explicit agreement is in place for every person shown for temporary AI-assisted recognition and the transfer of reduced images to Google.
criteria.confirmRequired: Please tick the age confirmation (and the reference-photo confirmation, if applicable) to continue.
criteria.dedupDesc: How aggressively to remove similar photos
criteria.noPhotosConfigure: No photos in memory. Please upload photos first.
